lines.en: Enough with the dividing, enough with the suffering,

lines.cyr: кога за истото сите се бориме.
lines.lat: koga za istoto site se borime.
lines.en: when we are all fighting for the same thing.
When, when will we be united,

lines.cyr: кога ли, кога, ние едно ќе бидиме?
lines.lat: koga li, koga, nie edno ḱe bidime?
lines.en: when, when, will we be one?

lines.cyr: Везден се мислам, везден се прашувам,
lines.lat: Vezden se mislam, vezden se prašuvam,
lines.en: All this time I'm thinking, all this time I am asking,

lines.cyr: умот го губам, јас ќе изгорам.
lines.lat: umot go gubam, jas ḱe izgoram.
lines.en: I'm losing my mind, I'm burning out.
When, when will we be united,

lines.cyr: кога ли, кога, ние едно ќе бидиме?
lines.lat: koga li, koga, nie edno ḱe bidime?
lines.en: when, when, will we be one?
Blood is thicker than water, brothers,
When, when will we be united,

lines.cyr: кога ли, кога, ние едно ќе бидиме?
lines.lat: koga li, koga, nie edno ḱe bidime?
lines.en: when, when, will we be one?
